<issue>
Non-copyable type accepted in regular interface impl but rejected in dyn interface
## Issue Description

A struct marked `[__NonCopyableType]` used as a field in a regular interface implementation compiles without error, even though `dyn` interfaces reject non-copyable members with error 33081. AnyValue marshalling copies data at the byte level, bypassing copy restrictions, which may violate the invariants that non-copyable semantics are meant to enforce.

## Reproducer Code

```hlsl
interface IFoo { int get(); }
[__NonCopyableType]
struct NonCopyData { int val; }
export struct Impl : IFoo {
    NonCopyData data;
    int get() { return 1; }
}
export struct GoodImpl : IFoo {
    int v;
    int get() { return v; }
}
RWStructuredBuffer<int> out;
[numthreads(1,1,1)]
void computeMain() {
    IFoo f = createDynamicObject<IFoo>(0, 0);
    out[0] = f.get();
}
```

**Command:**
```bash
slangc -target spirv test.slang
```

## Expected Behavior

Error diagnostic rejecting non-copyable field, consistent with `dyn` interface validation (error 33081).

## Actual Behavior

Compiles successfully (exit 0) with no warnings or errors.

## Test to Enable

When fixed, enable the DISABLED test `tests/language-feature/dynamic-dispatch/diagnose-noncopyable-in-impl.slang`.


</issue>

The repository is at /testbed.

Also find where createDynamicObject / AnyValue size checks for existential types happen (e.g. checks of types conforming to interface, in IR passes like lowerExistentials / anyvalue marshalling). Report file paths, line numbers and code snippets.

The test file expects the opposite: a non-copyable field in a regular interface impl is accepted, and the only diagnostic it checks is 'type cannot be packed' (TypeCannotBePackedIntoAnyValue). AnyValue size checks live in slang-ir-any-value-inference.cpp and slang-ir-lower-dynamic-dispatch-insts.cpp. I did not find a function literally named lowerExistentials. Nothing was modified.","findings":["Error 33081 definition: source/slang/slang-diagnostics.lua:1544-1547 — err(\"cannot-have-non-copyable-member-when-inheriting-dyn-interface\", 33081, ..., \"cannot have non-copyable member '~member' when inheriting from dyn interface '~interface:Decl'.\")","Emission: source/slang/slang-check-decl.cpp:465-479 — inside the AggTypeDecl parent check for a dyn-interface inheritance: `for (auto varDecl : aggTypeDeclParent->getDirectMemberDeclsOfType<VarDecl>())`, then `if (isNonCopyableType(varDecl->getType())) { sink->diagnose(Diagnostics::CannotHaveNonCopyableMemberWhenInheritingDynInterface{ .interface = interfaceDecl, .member = varDecl}); }`. Lines 12-13 are DISABLE_DIAGNOSTIC_TEST SIMPLE(diag=CHECK) runs for spirv and hlsl with -conformance Impl:IFoo=0 and GoodImpl:IFoo=1. Struct `Impl : IFoo` (line ~20) holds `NonCopyData data;` (`[__NonCopyableType]`, line ~8). Expected diagnostics at lines 27-28: `CHECK: ^^^^ type cannot be packed for dynamic dispatch` and `CHECK: type 'Impl' contains fields that cannot be packed into ordinary bytes for dynamic dispatch.` The test ends by calling createDynamicObject<IFoo>(dynId, 0) and f.get().","Related test tests/compute/interface-qualifiers/dyn-on-type-uses.slang:138-143 expects error[E33081] on dyn-interface cases.","createDynamicObject is declared in source/slang/core.meta.slang:3322 as `T createDynamicObject(uint typeId, U value);`. It sorts interface types topologically, takes max getNaturalSizeAndAlignment over implementations, and adds IRAnyValueSizeDecoration (lines ~291-294, ~328-341). It emits Diagnostics::TypeDoesNotFitAnyValueSize at lines 276 and 311 when an impl exceeds the existing size limit.","Marshalling: source/slang/slang-ir-any-value-marshalling.cpp:16 `AnyValueMarshallingContext`; ensureAnyValueType at line 82 (names generated types AnyValue<N>); generatePackingFunc at 688 and generateUnpackingFunc at 1068 emit packAnyValue<N>/unpackAnyValue<N>. Header: source/slang/slang-ir-any-value-marshalling.h."],"confidence":0.8}

content.content: {"summary":"canTypeBeStored is defined once at namespace scope in slang-ir-autodiff.cpp. Non-copyable is an IR decoration (kIROp_NonCopyableTypeDecoration / IRNonCopyableTypeDecoration) added during lowering from the AST attribute. No IR-level isNonCopyableType helper exists; the only one is the AST version in slang-ast-type.cpp, and IR code checks the decoration directly.","findings":["canTypeBeStored at source/slang/slang-ir-autodiff.cpp:921-958, declared in slang-ir-autodiff.h:621. Full body: `if (!type) return false; if (as<IRBasicType>(type)) return true; switch (type->getOp()) { case kIROp_StructType, kIROp_OptionalType, kIROp_ConditionalType, kIROp_ArrayType, kIROp_DifferentialPairType, kIROp_InterfaceType, kIROp_AssociatedType, kIROp_AnyValueType, kIROp_ClassType, kIROp_FloatType, kIROp_VectorType, kIROp_CoopVectorType, kIROp_MatrixType, kIROp_BackwardDiffIntermediateContextType, kIROp_BackwardDiffMinimalContextType, kIROp_BackwardContextFromLegacyBwdDiffFunc, kIROp_BackwardMinimalContextFromLegacyBwdDiffFunc: return true; case kIROp_AttributedType: return canTypeBeStored(type->getOperand(0)); case kIROp_TupleType: for each operand, skip IRTupleNameType, return false if any operand is not storable; return true; default: return false; }`. It does not check the non-copyable decoration.","A separate member function canTypeBeStored(IRType*) is at source/slang/slang-ir-lower-dynamic-dispatch-insts.cpp:686. It checks bindless resource rules and natural size/alignment.","The decoration is declared in source/slang/slang-ir-insts.lua:2123-2127 as nonCopyable = { struct_name = \"NonCopyableTypeDecoration\" }, commented 'Marks a type to be non copyable, causing SSA pass to skip turning variables of the type into SSA values.'. The C++ class IRNonCopyableTypeDecoration and kIROp_NonCopyableTypeDecoration are generated from it.","Builder method at source/slang/slang-ir-insts.h:5085-5088: addNonCopyableTypeDecoration(IRInst* value) calls addDecoration(value, kIROp_NonCopyableTypeDecoration).","Attached during lowering at source/slang/slang-lower-to-ir.cpp:11660-11661: for each decl modifier that is NonCopyableTypeAttribute, subBuilder->addNonCopyableTypeDecoration(irAggType).","Consumers: slang-ir-addr-inst-elimination.cpp:135-137 uses getResolvedInstForDecorations(valType)->findDecoration<IRNonCopyableTypeDecoration>() to skip non-copyable pointee types; slang-ir-link.cpp:485 handles kIROp_NonCopyableTypeDecoration in a switch.","AST helpers: isCopyableType(Type*) = !isNonCopyableType (slang-ast-type.cpp:2391-2393). isNonCopyableType(Type*) (slang-ast-type.cpp:2395-2404; declared slang-ast-type.h:1369) checks DeclRefType and findModifier<NonCopyableTypeAttribute>(). The attribute class is in slang-ast-modifier.h:1991.","No IR helper named isNonCopyableType or similar exists in source/slang; the only IR-side reference to the decoration type is the addNonCopyableTypeDecoration builder plus the consumers above."],"confidence":0.85}
